profile.headline: Lead .Net FullStack Developer
profile.summary: A talented individual with architect level Microsoft MVC experience able to design, implement, integrate and support the most challenging MVC ASP.Net solutions. Experienced working with Microsoft development stack and web technologies.  Demonstrates the utmost customer service attitude, dependable work ethic, with the ability to take initiative and ownership of coding. Consistently seeks to develop and refine best practices for infrastructure projects. Fluent in English and Spanish.

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed an application to fire notifications for TechOps based on location. This application is deployed on AWS, making use of S3 buckets, Elastic Beanstalk, Sage Master, Lambda Expressions, Gateway Endpoint.
-	Architected and developed an application for senior leadership to monitor their devises and create backups of desired files. 
-	Worked with security and infrastructure on a script to remove default configuration on 1,500+ Epson printers.
-	Created a windows forms tool to watermark office documents using OpenXML, the application is distributed to all division on application catalog.
-	Architected and developed an ASP.Net/MVC/Web API/AngularJS construction tracking tool, this tools track all the involving work of multiple teams on before and after the construction process. 
-	Developed an ETL process that pulls data from Salesforce and in-house application to seed data for the developed construction tracking tool.
-	Created a WCF service that is called by the IVR to define segmentations. 
-	Defined unit testing and integration testing using Moq and Autofixture to ensure application functionality.
-	Created a tracking tool for marketing department to track all stores in division. 
-	Managed migration to Cyber-Arc, made testing and defined an action plan for Application Development.
-	Defined the architecture for Angular 5 applications to standardize file structure across development team.
-	Guided developers on front-end or back-end requirements to keep projects on track by having daily stand ups and promotion learning sessions..
-Created a console app for IT Services to track employee logins to company devices.
-Requested and deployed 50+ SSL certificates.
-Responsible to migrate multiple legacy applications to a new environment which is load-balanced between two datacenters. To process includes request VIPS, GSLB, Firewall request, certificates.

positions.title: Application Developer 3
positions.description:
General tasks:
-Mentorship to junior developers.
-Implemented TFS Build and Release Manager for division use.

SSIS Packages
-Created a package to import data from SharePoint.
-Created a package to import account into the billing system.
-Created a package to import data from Teradata and process the imported data to the application tables using and ADO.Net connector for Teradata.

SharePoint
-Troubleshooting leader on SharePoint.
-Created the branding for SharePoint 2013 for two departments.
-Created a feature stapler to standardize the sites.
-Created multiple page layouts.
-Set up search.
-Set up apps environment.
-Created display templates for search web part.
-Created multiple carousel web parts.
-Migrated multiple sites.
-Created a workflow to approve employee time-off.
-Created a WPF app to import data from SharePoint to a database.
-Support to SharePoint, giving permission.
-Fixed user profile service application.
-Created a farm for contractors that uses server failover.
-Created documentation to recreate the farm contractors.
-Created a Web Part that calls Virtual Hold to connect an agent with a customer.

Web Development
-Created an app to display information from Comcast Stores.
-Created a module to display information using the Google Maps API.
-Created an angular app to manage the construction process (Designed, coded back-end, created custom UI with Comcast branding)
 

SQL
-Created Stored Procedure to process more than 60k accounts.
-Translated MSSQL queries to Teradata queries.
-Translated MSSQL queries to Oracle queries.
***Technologies used: ASP.NET, SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013, SharePoint Designer, AngularJS, KnockOut.JS, Twitter Bootstrap 3, SQL Server 2008, SQL Server 2010, SQL Server 2014, Teradata, Oracle 11g, Site Templates, SharePoint Hosted Apps, AJAX, JavaScript, HTML, CSS3, Team Foundation Server, Search Center, Content Types,  Power Shell, Bing Maps API, Google Maps API.

positions.title: Sharepoint Consultant
positions.description:
Developed SharePoint Hosted apps using Knockout.JS, Twitter Bootstrap, and Kendo UI.
Created web parts.
Tutor developers to build apps using Knockout.JS, Twitter Bootstrap and KendoUI.
Defined best practices for deliverables.
Define Search Center.
Defined verticals for search.
Defined refiners for search result page.
Create custom Site Templates
Create a Timer Job to define a sharepoint group from Active directory.
Defined search governance.
Created content types with retention policy.
Created custom WCF rest service to pull data from SharePoint and external sources.
Created a custom BCS to pull data from Oracle Database and SQL Server database.
Created a master page using bootstrap for branding.
Created a stapler for master page provisioning.

positions.title: .Net Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Permission Module
-	Created the assign permission view for the users using KnockOutJS
-	This view was dynamically generated from the database.
-	Implemented DevExpress views to display all the users of the system.

Global System
-	Created all the views of the system from pictures given by the client. 
-	Added a jQuery Date Picker and Time Picker using Twitter Bootstrap framework. Also created documentation to let the other developers how to use this.
-	Fixed the layout by modifying the CSS.
-	Added a Dev-Express grid on each page to display a big list of information.
-	Added global functions for the URL of the web service consumed by KnockOutJS code.
-	Created KnockoutJS custom bindings to accomplish a date issue for insurance (Start and End date for the insurance).
-	Created a standard for coding with the developing team.
-	Fixed DevExpress Grid layout.
Personnel Module
-	Created the add/update view using KnockOutJS.
-	Implemented validations using KnockOut-Validation and KnockOut Dirty Flag.
-	Implemented a DevExpress Grid to display the personnel in the database.
Insurance Module
-	Created the add/update view using KnockOutJS.
-	Implemented validations using KnockOut-Validation and KnockOut Dirty Flag.
-	Created custom bindings to handle start and end dates from an insurance claim.
***Main technologies used: ASP.NET, C#.NET, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML, SQL Server 2013,  Store Procedures, DevExPress, SVN.

positions.title: .Net Web-Developer
positions.description:
Web Store
-	Created a web store to sell the products of the company using MVC 4 and asp.net.
-	Worked closely with the sales department to gather requirements for how the discount of the items will be applied in the cart, depending in the quantity and the time of the year.
-	The system was designed to sell and manage subscriptions, with a discount included where necessary based on business rules and depending on the items in the shopping cart.
-	Added custom user interface to show the map of Mexico and the customer could select a state to buy (each state was an item). This was created using JavaScript, jQuery and Raphael Library to draw vectors.
-	Integrated the asp.net site with the PayPal payment system API.
-	Emails sent to customers were customised using inline CSS styles.
-	Developed a customer facing portal, where orders can be viewed, passwords updated, view status of current subscriptions, and receipts printed.
*** Technologies used: ASP.Net, C#, MVC4, Entity Framework, LINQ, SQL Server 2012, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, PayPal API, Mercurial.
Windows 8 Twitter App
-	Created a client twitter app for Windows 8, this was used on a demo for Tecnologico de Monterrey.
-	The app can get all the tweets from the used account.
-	The app can tweet with images.
*** Technologies used: XAML, C#, Twitter API.

Web page to display a map
-	 Created an asp.net web application to display points in a map. This was used to display the location of every mining company in Mexico. Used a Telerik grid to display all the companies in a view.
 *** Technologies used: MVC3, ASP .NET, C#, MapDotNet, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, Telerik.

positions.title: .Net Web Developer
positions.description:
Created a web application for the sales department to track every sales project they had. 
-	Took the requirements of the system from the sales manager, and created the business rules to provide the behaviour to the application.
-	Designed the architecture of the relational database implemented in SQL server 2010.
-	The system was linked to the ERP of the company, power builder, to get the catalogue of products they sell and make an estimation for the total of the project. 
-	The system generates reports in *.xlsx useful for the sales manager. This saved him 4 hours of work generating those reports.
 ***Technologies used: aspx.net, MVC 3, Entity Framework, LINQ, SQL Server 2010, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS3, HTML5, Bootstrap, SVN, IIS, BCS

Accounting Department.
-	Created a custom application page that generates reports in .txt, .cvs, and .pdf formatted files. This data was gathered from the custom ERP built in Power Builder that utilized SQL Anywhere Database.
***Technologies used: ASP.NET, Web Forms, SQL Server 2010, SQL Anywhere, ODBC Paradox, PARADOX database, Pascal, Delphi.

Web Application to manage the attending of a congress.
-	Created a MVC 3 web application.
-	Used twitter bootstrap for the layout, and branded it using custom CSS Clases.
-	The system managed 4 separate groups with limited assistance, so an AJAX call was made each time a user picked a conference to verify if it was not full.
-	It generated the badge with the schedule for each participant, so the user of the system only needed to print it and give to the participant.
-	The participant could register himself on the web, once completed an event receiver was triggered to send an email to the user with his schedule. 
*** Technologies used: ASP.NET, Web Forms, Bootstrap, AJAX, CSS

 Provided support to a third party accounting system (contpaq).
-	Updated the database to fulfil the Account Manager requirements.
 ***Technologies used: SQLServer 2010

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-	Added functions to the web application SIGEFA, a development of the company CSWEB. The application manages all the administrative processes of CONALEP.
o	Edit catalog entries such as:
	A field to capture certificates of PSP (Prestadores de Servicios Profesionales)
	An option to edit the PSP.
	Normalization of PSP ID’s
	Export data to a CSV file.
	A calendar to capture the dates of quizzes.
	The administrator could give the roles to users to create/edit/activate the calendar
	The administrator can create quizzes with multiple option, open answer.
	Export to a CSV and PDF the PSP signed in the curses.
	The creation of a log for the activity in the system.
	Include charts in the PDF and CSV reports
Main technologies used: PHP, ActionScript 3, Flex 3, PosgreSQL, Smarty, SVN.
